summary: Vylor Inc., a wholly owned Corteva subsidiary, filed an 8-K reporting the expiration and final results of private exchange offers and consent solicitations for three series of EIDP senior notes. Validly tendered and not withdrawn: 86.97% of the 2.300% notes due 2030 ($434.8M of $500M), 95.24% of the 5.125% notes due 2032 ($476.2M of $500M), and 87.93% of the 4.800% notes due 2033 ($527.6M of $600M). The offers expired September 30, 2026. This is a routine intra-group debt liability-management exchange, not a special situation; watch for settlement mechanics and any remaining outstanding EIDP notes.
